verdict.rationale: A real end-to-end probe installed just one skill with `npx skills add obra/superpowers --skill test-driven-development`, which copied only that skill folder into ./.claude/skills/. This confirms the skills are plain, individually installable markdown folders (the skills/ directory is the shared source of truth). However, this goes through a generic third-party installer, while Superpowers' own documented install paths all install the whole plugin bundle (`/plugin install superpowers@superpowers-marketplace`, `devin plugins install obra/superpowers`, per-harness installs). missing for 10: first-party documented per-skill selection, a native plugin/marketplace option to pick individual skills, and guidance on how skipped skills interact with the auto-triggering bootstrap.
